title: Snap scroll
summary: A vertical reel of cards scrolls past in 3D and snaps onto B; neighbours dim and tilt away.
signature: snapScroll(a, b, p, { duration, count, gap, perspective })

params.name: duration
params.description: length of the transition in seconds; springs use it to keep their feel

params.name: count
params.description: number of cards in the reel

notes: A vertical reel of cards (copies of A and B between them) scrolls past in 3D and snaps onto B; neighbours dim, shrink and tilt away.
Stack A and B in one positioned slot (their parent); give the slot overflow:hidden to keep travel inside it.
Pass the real duration in seconds and call it through p = 1: that is when it hides the layers it made.
Draws live copies of the card: a Paper shader canvas inside comes out blank.
when: lists, feeds, choosing one of many
